title: WikiGap: Promoting Epistemic Equity by Surfacing Knowledge Gaps Between English Wikipedia and other Language Editions

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting and comparing sentence-level factual gaps between English Wikipedia and other language editions (French, Russian, Chinese) using a multilingual LLM pipeline (InfoGap), and conducting a user study to evaluate how surfacing these missing facts challenges the 'English-as-superset' assumption.

Evaluating user responses to culturally specific facts (using traditional food articles as a domain proxy) that are exclusively present in non-English Wikipedia editions, using fact-finding quizzes and qualitative interviews to measure shifts in perceived epistemic equity.
